Hi Maria — adding a little more color from a controls / evidence perspective.

We will provide an evidence index (attached) that maps each control family to the artifacts we can share. Important clarifications:

- Tenant isolation: For Hosted mode customers we provide per-tenant logical isolation backed by our multi-tenant controls; for Dedicated pools customers receive isolated GPU pools with network segmentation and separate tenancy metadata. The control implementation is the same team/owners, but the technical enforcement differs (multi-tenant ACLs vs physical pool isolation).

- Backfilled coverage: If a customer cutover occurred mid-period, we will note the exact cutover timestamp and provide logs from both environments for the relevant time windows. The bridge letter will explicitly state which controls were continuous and which required environment-specific evidence.

- Evidence delivery: we'll upload the artifacts to an access-controlled Drive folder and provide sha256 checksums for the larger exports.
